Specification: A TLA+ formalization of proofs for Lamport's distributed mutual exclusion algorithm. It establishes type correctness, basic safety invariants (NetworkInv, CommInv), clock-related invariants (ClockInv), and finally verifies the Mutual Exclusion (Mutex) property using hierarchical proofs and various provers (Zenon, Isa, SMTT).

AssumeProveBlocks: ASSUME network \in [Proc -> [Proc -> Seq(Message)]], NEW s \in Proc, NEW m \in Message PROVE Broadcast(s,m) \in [Proc -> Seq(Message)]
SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK, [Next]_vars PROVE TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc, Request(p) PROVE TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc, Enter(p) PROVE TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc, Exit(p) PROVE TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc, NEW q \in Proc \ {p}, ReceiveRequest(p,q) PROVE TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc, NEW q \in Proc \ {p}, ReceiveAck(p,q) PROVE TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc, NEW q \in Proc \ {p}, ReceiveRelease(p,q) PROVE TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), NEW mtype, ~ Contains(s,mtype) PROVE AtMostOne(s, mtype)
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), NEW mt1, NEW mt2, ~ Contains(s, mt2) PROVE /\ Precedes(s, mt1, mt2) /\ Precedes(s, mt2, mt1)
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), NEW mt1, NEW mt2, s # << >>, Precedes(s,mt1,mt2), Head(s).type = mt2 PROVE ~ Contains(s,mt1)
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), NEW mtype, s # << >>, AtMostOne(s, mtype) PROVE AtMostOne(Tail(s), mtype)
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), s # << >>, NEW mtype, AtMostOne(s, mtype) PROVE Contains(Tail(s), mtype) <=> Contains(s, mtype) /\ Head(s).type # mtype
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), NEW mtype, AtMostOne(s,mtype), s # << >>, Head(s).type = mtype PROVE ~ Contains(Tail(s), mtype)
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), NEW mtype, NEW m \in Message PROVE Contains(Append(s,m), mtype) <=> m.type = mtype \/ Contains(s, mtype)
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), NEW mtype, ~ Contains(s, mtype), NEW m \in Message PROVE /\ AtMostOne(Append(s,m), mtype) /\ m.type # mtype => ~ Contains(Append(s,m), mtype)
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), NEW mtype, AtMostOne(s, mtype), NEW m \in Message, m.type # mtype PROVE AtMostOne(Append(s,m), mtype)
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), NEW mt1, NEW mt2, NEW m \in Message, m.type # mt1 PROVE Precedes(Append(s,m), mt1, mt2) <=> Precedes(s, mt1, mt2)
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), NEW mt1, NEW mt2, Precedes(s, mt1, mt2) PROVE Precedes(Tail(s), mt1, mt2)
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), s # << >>, NEW mt1, NEW mt2, mt1 # mt2, Head(s).type = mt1 \/ Head(s).type \notin {mt1, mt2}, Precedes(Tail(s), mt1, mt2) PROVE Precedes(s, mt1, mt2)
SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK, BasicInv, [Next]_vars PROVE BasicInv'
ASSUME NEW n \in Proc, Request(n) PROVE BasicInv'
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc, NEW q \in Proc PROVE NetworkInv(p,q)'
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc PROVE CommInv(p)'
ASSUME NEW q \in Proc \ {n} PROVE /\ q \notin ack'[p] /\ Contains(network'[p][q], "req") /\ ~ Contains(network'[q][p], "ack")
ASSUME NEW n \in Proc, Enter(n) PROVE BasicInv'
ASSUME NEW n \in Proc, Exit(n) PROVE BasicInv'
ASSUME NEW q \in Proc PROVE Contains(network'[q][p], "ack") <=> Contains(network[q][p], "ack")
ASSUME NEW n \in Proc, NEW k \in Proc \ {n}, ReceiveRequest(n,k) PROVE BasicInv'
ASSUME NEW n \in Proc, NEW k \in Proc \ {n}, ReceiveAck(n,k) PROVE BasicInv'
ASSUME NEW n \in Proc, NEW k \in Proc \ {n}, ReceiveRelease(n,k) PROVE BasicInv'
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc, CommInv(p) PROVE CommInv(p)'
ASSUME NEW q \in Proc, p # k \/ q # n PROVE Contains(network'[p][q], "rel") <=> Contains(network[p][q], "rel")
SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK, BasicInv, ClockInv, [Next]_vars PROVE ClockInv'
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc, NEW q \in Proc \ {p} PROVE ClockInvInner(p,q)'

ASSUME Contains(qp', "ack") \/ q \in ack'[p] PROVE /\ req'[q][p] = req[p][p] /\ clock'[q] > req'[p][p] /\ Precedes(qp', "ack", "req") => \A i \in 1 .. Len(qp') : qp'[i].type = "req" => qp'[i].clock > req'[p][p]
ASSUME NEW n \in Proc, Exit(n) PROVE ClockInv'
ASSUME Precedes(qp', "ack", "req"), NEW i \in 1 .. Len(qp'), qp'[i].type = "req" PROVE FALSE
ASSUME NEW i \in 1 .. Len(pq'), pq'[i].type = "req" PROVE i \in 1 .. Len(pq) /\ pq'[i] = pq[i]
ASSUME p \in crit' PROVE beats(p,q)'
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc , NEW q \in Proc \ {p}, ClockInvInner(p,q) PROVE ClockInvInner(p,q)'
ASSUME Precedes(qp', "ack", "req") PROVE Precedes(qp, "ack", "req")
ASSUME NEW i \in 1 .. Len(qp'), qp'[i].type = "req" PROVE i+1 \in 1 .. Len(qp) /\ qp'[i] = qp[i+1]
ASSUME NEW i \in 1 .. Len(pq') PROVE i+1 \in 1 .. Len(pq) /\ pq'[i] = pq[i+1]
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc, NEW q \in Proc, ClockInvInner(p,q) PROVE ClockInvInner(p,q)'
SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK, BasicInv, ClockInv, NEW p \in crit, NEW q \in crit, p # q PROVE FALSE
